on_battle_start: Gears turn, steam rises, and iron wills are forged in this workshop. Let's begin.
Steel does not bend easily. Show me your resolve, trainer.
on_battle_won: The machine runs smoothly, unbothered by your challenge. Return once you're sharper.
Iron wills are not broken so easily. Come back stronger.
on_battle_lost: Remarkable. You've bent steel itself. Take this badge, engineer.
The gears grind to a halt before your strength. Well earned.
